# CI Pipeline Sequence Diagram — GitHub Actions + ArgoCD

> 來源：docs/CICD.md §1.1 GitHub Actions + ArgoCD 架構圖 + §1.3 Pipeline Stage 總覽 + §2 Workflow YAML + §7.3 GitOps 部署流程。
> 描述從 `git push` 到 staging smoke test 完整 CI 執行流程；Production deploy 為 manual approval gate（不在本圖）。

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Dev as Developer
    participant GH as GitHub.com
    participant Runner as GitHub Runner (ubuntu-latest)
    participant GHCR as ghcr.io Registry
    participant Argo as ArgoCD
    participant K8s as Staging K8s
    participant Slack as Slack

    Dev->>GH: git push / open PR
    GH->>Runner: Trigger workflow (push / pull_request)
    Runner->>Runner: Stage 1: Checkout (actions/checkout@v4)
    Runner->>Runner: Stage 2: Build (make ci-build — dotnet build)
    Runner->>Runner: Stage 3: Unit Test (make ci-test-unit — xUnit + coverage)
    Runner->>Runner: Stage 4: Integration Test (make ci-test-integration — Testcontainers PG)

    alt PR to main
        Runner-->>GH: Status check: build / unit-test / integration-test (PASS)
        Note over GH,Runner: PR Gate gating; merge blocked if any FAIL
    else push to main
        Runner->>Runner: Stage 5: Image Build (Kaniko / docker buildx)
        Runner->>GHCR: docker push ghcr.io/erp-org/erp-api-token-manager:${SHA}
        GHCR-->>Runner: 201 Created (image digest)
        Runner->>GH: Stage 5b: Update helm values (commit-back) image.tag = SHA
        GH->>Argo: Webhook / poll detects helm chart change
        Argo->>K8s: Stage 6: ArgoCD sync (kubectl apply / helm upgrade)
        K8s-->>Argo: Pods Ready (3/3 replicas Healthy)
        Argo-->>Runner: Sync status: Synced + Healthy
        Runner->>K8s: Stage 7: Smoke Test (make ci-smoke — curl /health, /metrics, POST /api/v1/me/tokens)

        alt Smoke PASS
            K8s-->>Runner: 200 OK (all 3 endpoints respond)
            Runner->>GH: Status check: smoke-test PASS
            Runner->>Slack: notify success ${SHA} ${actor}
        else Smoke FAIL
            K8s-->>Runner: 5xx / timeout
            Runner->>K8s: Rollback: make ci-rollback (helm rollback / argocd rollback)
            K8s-->>Runner: Previous revision restored
            Runner->>GH: Status check: smoke-test FAIL
            Runner->>Slack: notify FAIL + rollback ${SHA}
        end
    end
```

## Stage 對照（與 CICD.md §1.3 與 §4.1 一致）

| Stage # | 名稱 | Make Target | 必經/可選 |
|---------|------|------------|----------|
| 1 | Checkout | (actions/checkout@v4) | 必經 |
| 2 | Build | `make ci-build` | 必經 |
| 3 | Unit Test | `make ci-test-unit` | 必經 |
| 4 | Integration Test | `make ci-test-integration` | 必經 |
| 5 | Image Build | Kaniko / buildx | 僅 push to main |
| 5b | Update Helm Values | `gh api ... commit-back` | 僅 push to main |
| 6 | Deploy（ArgoCD sync）| ArgoCD（自動） | 僅 push to main |
| 7 | Smoke Test | `make ci-smoke` | 僅 push to main |
| 8 | Production Deploy | manual approval gate | 不在 CI（人工） |

## 失敗路徑

| 失敗 Stage | 行為 |
|-----------|------|
| 1–4（PR Gate） | PR status check FAIL → 阻止 merge |
| 5（Image Build） | Workflow FAIL；不更新 helm values；Slack alert |
| 7（Smoke Test） | 自動執行 `make ci-rollback`；恢復前一版本；Slack alert |
